name: Aries
omens: Aries wants to act now, so the company launched before anyone decided how it looks.
Aries feels the company racing ahead while its image lags behind.
Impatience burns in Aries: each day without a good site is a lost chance.
Aries starts and rarely finishes. The brand needs someone to close the details.

name: Taurus
omens: Taurus prizes what lasts, and the company has looked the same for years.
Taurus clings to the proven while clients look for something new.
Taurus sees quality in the product but not in how the company presents itself.
Taurus's calm hides a fear that the competition looks better.

name: Gemini
omens: Gemini speaks to clients in two voices and neither sounds like the company.
Gemini has a thousand ideas, yet the brand still does not know who it is.
Gemini hears the company's message tangle like an echo in a crypt.
Gemini's duality shows in the materials: two logos, three typefaces.

name: Cancer
omens: Cancer guards the company like a shell, yet clients cannot see what is inside.
Cancer feels more than it shows. The brand also hides its best sides.
Cancer fears change, and a change of look is what would refresh the company.
Cancer remembers every client, but the company gives them nothing worth remembering.

name: Leo
omens: Leo wants to shine, yet nobody sees the company in the crowd.
Lion's pride is not enough: the brand's glow must be designed.
Leo roars and clients hear only noise. A striking image is missing.
Leo deserves a crown, but the company still wears a borrowed hat.

name: Virgo
omens: Virgo has everything buttoned up, only clients get lost on the site.
Virgo spots every flaw in the company, including the one in the site layout.
Virgo orders the processes while the company's look waits in line for years.
Virgo knows the value of detail: misaligned margins hurt her more than the client.

name: Libra
omens: Libra weighs options so long that the company still has no final look.
Libra craves harmony, yet the company's materials look like different eras.
Libra wants to please everyone. The brand needs one clear style.
Libra feels something is uneven in the company and is right: no coherent visual system.

name: Scorpio
omens: Scorpio sees beneath the surface and knows the company's image betrays it.
Scorpio holds a secret: more quality than the brand shows.
Scorpio distrusts appearances. So do clients when a site looks abandoned.
Scorpio senses the competition biting while the company has no image to defend with.

name: Sagittarius
omens: Sagittarius aims high, yet the company's site never reaches the client.
Sagittarius seeks adventure while clients seek a clear offer.
Sagittarius fires in every direction. The brand needs a single target.
Sagittarius promises a far journey, but the company has no map for its clients.

name: Capricorn
omens: Capricorn climbs the ranks while the company still looks like a beginner.
Capricorn counts every penny, so the image keeps waiting for a budget.
Capricorn builds to last. The brand should show it, not only say it.
Capricorn is serious, yet the company's site speaks in the tone of a decade ago.

name: Aquarius
omens: Aquarius has a vision of the future while the company looks like the past.
Aquarius outruns the age, only clients have not noticed yet.
Aquarius prizes originality, so the company should not look like all the others.
Aquarius throws ideas into the ether and the brand has no vessel to catch them.

name: Pisces
omens: Pisces drifts with the current while the company has no image to show a direction.
Pisces feels the clients but cannot say the company in a single picture.
Pisces dreams, and the company lacks someone to draw those dreams.
Pisces drowns in the fog of its own ideas. A lighthouse is needed: a clear message.
